context: Evaluates the end-of-conversation rule: when the user wraps up with items open, the goal stays active, a handover is written and linked from its log, and both are persisted where the next session reads them. Covers the persistence step in the Workflow and the wrap-up handover step.

checklist.name: Goal not closed
checklist.description: goal-status is not set to completed or promoted while items 3 and 4 are open

checklist.name: Goal stays active
checklist.description: status stays active and goal-status in-progress

checklist.name: Handover written
checklist.description: A handover with context, progress and next step is written with handover-document-creator

checklist.name: Handover linked from log
checklist.description: The goal's log gains a dated line linking the handover

checklist.name: Persisted for the next session
checklist.description: The goal file and handover are committed where the next session reads them

checklist.name: Open items reported
checklist.description: The report names what is done, what is open, and the handover's path
